answer: Bind the key to a TEE quote. The enclave signs a nonce with a key that never leaves the chip, so one quote maps to one physical device. Deduct standing for each claim the operator cannot verify. Replay the input hash across the fleet so duplicates are caught by content, not by label. A whisper of spoofed quotes fails attestation, and a falcon of rented chips costs more per identity than an epoch pays out. At the zenith, cost per verified identity is one device plus one quote per epoch.
